rows.line: 命をかけちゃダメだから
rows.en2: Don't put your life on the line for it.

rows.line: 子供が朝5時起きで
rows.en1: The kid's up at five a.m.
rows.en2: up at the crack of dawn

rows.line: 子どもに我慢させてでも行かせようとするんだな
rows.en1: They'll make the kid tough it out.
rows.en2: They push the kid to suck it up and go.

rows.line: 京都でブチギレたよ
行く方が悪い
まあまあまあ、年齢的にも50代やからなあ
rows.en1: Well, I mean, I'm in my fifties.

rows.line: まあまあ、しゃーないしゃーない
rows.en1: Oh well, it is what it is.

rows.line: もういいやと
十数年前からついていけなくなります
rows.en1: I stopped being able to keep up years ago.
rows.en2: I fell behind a while back.

rows.line: こっちの早すぎて
機能的にこれで十分なんです
新しいのすごいよ、使いこなされへん
rows.en1: It's amazing, but I can't figure it out.
rows.en2: I can't even use half of it.

rows.line: なんで買い替えたんすかと言われるような使い方
rows.en2: What'd you buy a new one for?

rows.line: 最初だけやん
わかる世代じゃないですか
rows.en1: We're the generation that gets that.
rows.en2: You know, our generation gets it.

rows.line: ユーチューバーとか、ブーブー言われる
自分が頑張れば頑張るほど
rows.en1: The harder you work, the more you make.
rows.en2: You get out what you put in.

rows.line: ちょろまかしてる奴が店長であったりする
rows.en1: Turns out the manager's skimming off the top.
rows.en2: The manager's the one pocketing cash.

rows.line: やっぱりそこでけじめってね
rows.en1: You've got to draw the line there.
rows.en2: Somebody has to answer for it.

rows.line: すごいはすごい
今みんな思ってる以上に賢い人が多いんで
rows.en1: People are way smarter than you think.
rows.en2: Folks are sharper than you'd expect.

rows.line: すぐめくれますね
基本的に怒る奴アホや
rows.en1: Anybody who gets mad is an idiot.
rows.en2: People who blow up are just dumb.

rows.line: アホばっかりでしょ
体験談はもう嘘つかなければ
rows.en1: As long as you don't lie about what happened.

rows.line: 確かに確かに
ほんまやなぁ
それしかないん
俺が入ってたら、どっちが折れる
そんなんでもうあかんで

rows.ja: おかしな奴がちょっと多い
rows.line: おかしな奴がちょっと多いと思って
rows.en2: Kind of a lot of oddballs.
